British Man's Naked Body Found in Sicily, Ritual Killing Feared

Italian authorities are investigating the death of a 35-year-old British man whose naked body was discovered in Sicily on Sunday. Police are exploring the possibility of a ritualistic killing, with one report mentioning the body was found near a goat's head. The man had reportedly disappeared while hillwalking. The investigation is ongoing.
